text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Hanshin JF. Witnessing the 
fierce determination of her fellow 
competitors, Hishi Amazon feels a rush of 
restless excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she is right in front of the 
juniors who came to cheer for her. 
Steeling herself once more, she vows not 
to lose.
